meta.title: Create an account
meta.description: Create a Friends of Animals account with your email address. We email you a code: there is no password to remember.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: Tell us your name and email address. We'll email you a code to finish. There's no password to remember.

meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to Friends of Animals with your email address and a code we email you. There is no password.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Enter your email address and we'll email you a code. There's no password.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: We'll email a 6-digit code to this address.
email.error: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.

code.label: 6-digit code
code.hint: We sent it to {email}. It works for {minutes} minutes.
code.error: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.

alerts.rate_limited: You've asked for a lot of codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
alerts.code_expired: That code has run out. Send yourself a new one.
alerts.too_many_attempts: That code had too many wrong tries. Send yourself a new one.
alerts.no_account: There's no account with this email address yet.
alerts.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

code.subject: Your Friends of Animals sign-in code
code.text:
Your sign-in code is {code}.

It works for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without the code.
